source_nets.basis: The lower page-3 return line reaches V6 and V19 lower-right leads and continues to V20 through the page boundary. The earlier V1 attribution was a cropped-label error: V1 is drawn separately on page 4.

source_nets.name: SYNC_DIVIDER_MID
source_nets.basis: The two resistor sections meet at the centre tap, which drops to C33 left.

source_nets.name: 12P
source_nets.basis: The printed 12P rail meets R11.2 outer-left and loops above the R11 sections to R37 upper. A page-edge match carries it to the R38-left/R39-upper junction; it crosses the R11.1 outer-right trace without a junction dot.

source_nets.name: SYNC_C
source_nets.basis: R11.1 outer-right descends to V6 upper-right and C33 right; R37 lower and V19 base join that line. The right-hand page-3 transistor is visibly V19 at 600 dpi, not page-4 V1 or upper-oscillator V10.

source_nets.name: FLYBACK_FEEDBACK
source_nets.basis: C17 lower crosses 00 without a junction, follows the printed Zeile = 15 kHz = X line to the page-3 right edge, and matches the page-4 V20 upper trace at both 300 and 600 dpi. This is the existing assembled h_feedback net.

source_nets.name: V19_UPPER
source_nets.basis: The V19 upper-right page-3 line matches the page-4 V20 bias-left trace at 300 and 600 dpi. C/E polarity of the printed 1SA20C remains provisional.

source_nets.name: 35P
source_nets.basis: The 35P line from page 3 continues to the page-4 V1 collector-side upper lead and R3 upper.

source_nets.name: V1_BASE
source_nets.basis: The 600 dpi page-4 crop shows R3 lower and R1 right meeting the left-facing V1 base.

source_nets.name: KRS
source_nets.basis: The page-4 V1 lower-right lead continues to the KRS connector line; R2 shunts KRS to 00. The separate page-18 panel read confirms KRS at X1:5.

model_status: V20 uses the same provisional SSY20A_BOUND NPN alias as printed-type peer V6; original 1SA20C electrical parameters and connected stress are not qualified.
unresolved_terminal_comparison: The page-3 right-hand transistor is V19, not V1.
